## Solución

```{r}
alpha <- 4; beta <- 7
# E(X) y Var(X)
cat("E(X)   =", alpha*beta, "días\n")
cat("Var(X) =", alpha*beta^2, "días²\n")
cat("sd(X)  =", round(sqrt(alpha*beta^2),2), "días\n")
# Percentil 90
cat("P90    =", round(qgamma(0.90, alpha, scale=beta), 2), "días\n")
# P(X < 20)
cat("P(X<20)=", round(pgamma(20, alpha, scale=beta), 4), "\n")
```
